_provenance.role: MEASUREMENT ONLY — quantifies the hour-level online-capability wedge behind the mid-band residual; not a model input, no apply seam. The per-hour ON series is an operational outcome: only its CONDITIONAL structure (net-load bin x season) may ever drive a mechanism (rule 13).
_provenance.caveat_hourly_lambda: actual RT is hourly (mean of 4-12 SCED intervals); intra-hour spikes are smoothed
_provenance.caveat_model_cap: model_cap = cap_hat x DAM class-day avail, with cap_hat inferred from the replay's own peak dispatch/avail ratio (no availability is persisted in bundles) — an estimate, tight because the LP dispatches full class capability in its scarcest hours
_provenance.caveat_overlay_identity: day_nonout (day-mean non-OUT HSL) is the model's capability level via the ercot_thermal_dam_availability overlay identity (only-OUT-is-out, class-day mean, flat within the day) — the comparison needs no fleet reconstruction
